# Metro Maids Cleaning Services

> Metro Maids Cleaning Services is a professional residential and commercial cleaning company based in Denver, Colorado, serving Denver, Cherry Creek and the Denver Tech Center (DTC). Cleaners are insured, bonded and background-checked.

## Key Facts
- Business name: Metro Maids Cleaning Services
- Phone: (801) 856-6403
- Email: contact@metromaidscleaning.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 8am–6pm, Saturday 9am–3pm
- Service area: Denver, Cherry Creek, Denver Tech Center (DTC), Greenwood Village, Centennial, Washington Park, Highlands, Capitol Hill, Stapleton/Central Park, Colorado
- Price range: Standard house cleaning typically starts around $120–$180 for a 2–3 bedroom home; final price depends on home size and condition
- Guarantee: 100% satisfaction guarantee — re-clean within 24 hours if not satisfied

## Services
- Standard House Cleaning — routine dusting, vacuuming, mopping, kitchen and bathroom sanitizing
- Deep Cleaning — baseboards, interior windows, grout, light fixtures, inside appliances, behind furniture
- Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning — for renters, landlords and realtors
- Recurring Maintenance Cleaning — weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly, discounted rate
- Office & Commercial Cleaning — flexible after-hours cleaning for offices and small businesses
- Post-Construction Cleaning — dust and debris removal after renovation or new builds

## How to Book
Visitors can request a free, no-obligation quote via the contact form at https://www.metromaidscleaning.com/#contact or by calling (801) 856-6403. Metro Maids Cleaning Services typically responds within one business day.
